new_theorem_summary: For h literal physical hubs and a leaf block D+sum lambda_k v_kv_k^T, if the augmented source-coordinate coefficient frame W=[v_1,...,v_r,c_1,...,c_h] has positive Gram determinant and positive Pluecker disjointness rho, then Q has a continuous density bounded by ((r+2h)/(r+2h-2))*exp((r+h)/(r+2h))*[rho det(W^TW) prod|lambda_k|]^(-1/(r+2h)); the same constant gives a linear interval bound. The full physical hub core and conditioned outside blocks are arbitrary.

partner_result_applied.actual_application: For Q_(2,m)=epsilon(X_1^2+X_2^2)+2X_1<c_1,Y>+2X_2<c_2,Y>+Z^2 with disjoint flat size-m leaf groups, Delta=1 and rho=(1-1/m)^2, so ||p||_infinity<=2sqrt(e)(1-1/m)^(-1/2); at m=16 this is <3.406.
